anvilAccounts.note: Anvil/Hardhat default public test accounts, derived from Anvil's well-known public test mnemonic (the standard 'test ... junk' phrase documented by Foundry). Addresses only; no private keys are stored in this file. Derive keys locally with `anvil` output or `cast wallet address --mnemonic ... --mnemonic-index N`.

warningRepeat: **WARNING: Fork-funded test accounts only. Do not fund these addresses on mainnet, Base, Arbitrum One, Robinhood Chain, or HyperEVM. Do not paste real keys into this repo.**

chains.fundedOn: local anvil fork of ethereum only (state lives in the anvil process; nothing is sent to the real network)
fundingSteps: 1. Start the fork: anvil --fork-url $ETHEREUM_NODE_MAINNET --port 8601 --chain-id 1
2. Mine one block once (avoids 'Excess blob gas not set' on some forks): cast rpc --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8601 evm_mine
3. Native ETH: cast rpc --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8601 anvil_setBalance <account> 0x56BC75E2D63100000   # 100 ETH
4a. USDC: script/fund-anvil.sh http://127.0.0.1:8601 <account> 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 1000000000   # 1000 USDC (6 dec); verified works, slot 9
4b. WETH: script/fund-anvil.sh http://127.0.0.1:8601 <account> 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 1000000000000000000   # 1 WETH; verified works, slot 3 (or call WETH.deposit{value})
Foundry tests/scripts alternative: deal(token, account, amount) from forge-std StdCheats.
Denomination asset for QA: USDC. Deployed addresses are reproducible with script/README.md (deterministic nonce-based CREATE from the sender).

chains.fundedOn: local anvil fork of hyperliquid (HyperEVM) only (state lives in the anvil process; nothing is sent to the real network)

sources: 1. on-chain read via https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm (eth_getCode + eth_call): name 'USDC', symbol USDC, 6 decimals (read 2026-10-02)
2. Circle's published USDC contract address list, row 'HyperEVM' (mainnet): https://developers.circle.com/stablecoins/usdc-contract-addresses (fetched 2026-10-02; address matches)

fundingSteps: 1. Start the fork: anvil --fork-url $ETHEREUM_NODE_HYPERLIQUID --port 8646 --chain-id 999 --gas-limit 30000000 --compute-units-per-second 25 --retries 20 --fork-retry-backoff 1000   # (public read-only RPC: https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm). --gas-limit 30000000 is REQUIRED: the fork inherits the 3M small-block gas limit of the fork block, and ComptrollerLib/VaultLib/FundDeployer need the 30M big-block limit (with a 3M fork the core deploy fails with OutOfGas). Anvil cannot enforce the small-block cap; a real deployment needs big blocks enabled for the deployer (L1 action evmUserModify usingBigBlocks=true).
2. Mine one block once: cast rpc --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8646 evm_mine
3. Native HYPE: cast rpc --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8646 anvil_setBalance <account> 0x56BC75E2D63100000   # 100 HYPE

4a. USDC (denomination asset, 6 dec, Circle native): script/fund-anvil.sh http://127.0.0.1:8646 <account> 0xb88339CB7199b77E23DB6E890353E22632Ba630f 1000000000   # 1000 USDC; verified works, balances slot 9

4b. WHYPE (wrapped native, 18 dec): cast send --unlocked --from <account> 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555 'deposit()' --value 5ether  (verified; impersonate the account first with anvil_impersonateAccount)
Foundry tests/scripts alternative: deal(token, account, amount) from forge-std StdCheats.
Do NOT use USDT0 (0xB8CE59FC3717ada4C02eaDF9682A9e934F625ebb), USDH (0x111111a1a0667d36bD57c0A9f569b98057111111), Unit-bridged tokens or any other token labelled USDC as the denomination asset.
Stock anvil does not implement the HyperCore precompiles (0x800..), so reads of them return empty; Enzyme core never calls them.

Reproduce the committed record: BROADCAST_LOCAL=1 script/fork-dry-run.sh hyperliquid <forkBlock>   (the wrapper starts its own anvil with --gas-limit 30000000 on port 8646; stop any other anvil on that port first)
Phase 1 only: create vault, deposit, redeem (AC-1,2,3,5,6). Swaps disabled (Phase 2).
